result.summary: Checked the five leads. I read the 1976 gazette (Decree No. 12, 19 states) and the 1967 gazette (Decree No. 14, 12 states) page by page as images. The 1996 archivi.ng speech was seen only as a fetch-tool text extract: six new states, Ebonyi from Abia and Enugu, a "30-state structure with a Federal Capital Territory", boundary adjustments deferred. The policyvault page (connection refused) and the UT map page (bot wall) could not be opened. The nigeriareposit home page shows no 1967 decree item. The 21, 30 and 36 counts, Kogi's 1991 creation and the FCT have no primary text read. Both gazette schedules use provinces, divisions and districts, and both decrees set up boundary commissions. The ADM1-based Stage 1 plan is therefore not supported as stated, though I did not compare schedule areas with modern ADM1 units. Reuse rights are unknown for all five sources.

changes.why: The memo the brief asks for: one table per source, state-count support table, effect on the Stage 0/1 scope, and the list of what still needs a source.

unverified_claims: Gazette transcriptions come from reading page images and were not copy-checked against extracted text.
1987 instrument number, date (23 Sept 1987), and parents (Kaduna, Cross River) come from search snippets only.
1991 instrument number (Decree No. 37 vs No. 41), date 27 Aug 1991, the nine states and Kogi's parents are from search snippets or memory only.
FCT creation by Decree No. 6 of 1976, its parent states, and the 12 Dec 1991 capital transfer are from search snippets only.
The 1996 decree number (No. 36) is from a search snippet only.
The archivi.ng quotes come from a fetch-tool extract, not from reading the full page.
Contents, date and licence of the UT 1993 map are not seen.
Whether any 1967 or 1976 schedule area cuts through a modern ADM1 unit was not compared.
Whether any boundary adjustment was actually enacted is not established.
open_questions_for_maintainer: Can you open policyvault.africa and the UT page in a browser and report contents and reuse terms?
What was the original nigeriareposit item URL for the 1967 lead?
Should 1967 and 1976 be shown at province/division level rather than from ADM1 geometry?
Is citing and describing the gazette scans enough, given that reuse rights are unknown?
Do you want a follow-up task to find primary texts for 1987, 1991, 1996 and the FCT, and to compare the 1967 and 1976 schedule areas with modern ADM1 units?
result.recommendation_reason: Only the 12 and 19 state counts are supported by primary text I read. Two of the five leads could not be opened and reuse rights are unknown for all five. The 21, 30, 36, Kogi and FCT claims still need primary sources.
